headline: Northern Hexes Churn While Stonecradle and Farranac Coast Erupt
war_summary: Since the previous edition, intense fighting has spread westward, with Stonecradle and Farranac Coast erupting into rapid base exchanges and surging casualties. In Stonecradle, three base transitions occurred over the last two hours around The Cord and Trammel Pool amid over twelve hundred casualties, while Farranac Coast recorded the capture of Transient Valley amidst a sudden casualty spike exceeding thirteen hundred. The northern theater remains in relentless turmoil: Stlican Shelf registered ten base transitions in the past two hours alone, while Weathered Expanse sustained over twenty-eight hundred combined casualties in the same span across hotly contested positions like Wightwalk and Shattered Advance. Viper Pit also flared back to life with three base events at Blackthroat. Though base lines have temporarily stabilized in Callahan's Passage, combat there continues at a blistering pace with more than twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy persists in attritional deadlock, and rear territories remain completely dormant.
